tailBindNote: The tail bones keep the directions of the source in the bind, so that the curl of the tail stays behind the haunch.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature). The half width holds the haunch (x -0.20 to 0.20).

eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the painted eye of each side (x 0.054 to 0.102, y 0.817 to 0.860, z 0.108 to 0.145 in the source). The eyes are faces of the head surface, with no eyeball. The nose box holds the snout disc.
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/studio-body.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: H of the body is 0.411693 m, the H of the pig of main (assets/models/pig/pig.rig.glb at cbc8db5e4). The fact height of the armature is the shoulder joints at this scale. The head, the trunk, the hooves, and the legs keep the form of the source.
jointsNote: The places are the places of the source, in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the head, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh. Arm (axis y 0.607, z -0.005, radius 0.067 where it leaves the trunk at x 0.165, 0.036 at x 0.34): the shoulder joint at x 0.13, in the trunk side, the elbow at x 0.24, in the middle from the shoulder to the wrist, the wrist at x 0.345, the thinnest place before the hoof, the knuckles at x 0.39, where the toes of the hoof part, the tip at x 0.427. Leg (the crotch at y 0.19): the hip joint at (0.095, 0.24, -0.01) in the haunch, the knee at (0.098, 0.13, -0.03), the ankle at (0.103, 0.045, -0.013), where the hoof starts, and the hoof tips at z 0.056. Trunk: the spine bones lie at about 0.35 of the depth from the back. The neck is narrowest at y 0.64 to 0.66, and the chin is at y 0.68. Ears: the root at (0.13, 0.93, 0), the tips at (0.25, 0.905, 0). Tail: the curl behind the rump (z below -0.19), from its root at (0, 0.355, -0.18) to (0, 0.35, -0.263). The palm is the true palm of the source: the mean normal of the hoof faces that face down (x from 0.36) is (0.243, -0.968, -0.067). The hoof turn of the build turns it with the hoof.
